{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/trial.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check the distribution of biomarker_baseline
print("\nDistribution of biomarker_baseline:")
print(data['biomarker_baseline'].describe())

# Count how many are exactly -999
missing_count = (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f"\nNumber of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {missing_count}")

# Check if there are duplicates in patient_id
duplicate_count = data['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f"\nNumber of duplicate patient_id entries: {duplicate_count}")

# Check the sample_seq for duplicates
print("\nMax sample_seq per patient_id:")
max_seq_per_patient = data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(max_seq_per_patient.value_counts())"}
